required_native_owners.watchdog_attach_boundary: Actual allocated watchdog attaches before fallible storage, daemon/runtime and provider checks.
required_native_owners.transport_attach_boundary: Actual Docker transport attaches before any marker/model input.
required_native_owners.monitor_policy: Main-thread select/os.read and timed wait check both owners every at most 0.5 seconds between I/O waits; no monitoring thread or concurrent lease close.

required_source_and_storage.exact_source_pins: Hook, proposed runner, process_security, four actually imported native SDK files, actual Python/Docker, resolved trusted Grok binary and ten direct dispatch helpers.
required_source_and_storage.source_reader: Stable owned single-link non-world-writable exact SHA256, streamed 1 MiB chunks, 256 MiB file bound; existing 0664 trusted implementations permitted only with all pins/metadata checks.
required_source_and_storage.external_storage: Actual SDK charge ancestry and hashed label join, full candidate workspace plus separate provider temporary root; private owner attempts and callback outputs separately charged.

qualification_stages.requires: Exact frozen bundle and harness copy; genuine finite native CPU/storage/child admission; unique external test aliases; no provider, model/auth, Docker or native acceptance calls. Actual proposed builders assemble only inert argv/fixtures with process execution prohibited.
qualification_stages.count_policy: Manifest controlled_testcases declares unique collected cases; successful subtest call reports counted separately. Source/AST inventory is not an actual test-pass claim.

qualification_stages.scope: Fresh finite non-model Docker/native gated lifecycle control
qualification_stages.requires: Both genuine actual owners with combined phase envelope, exact source/binary/helper pins and real storage promises. Observe actual watchdog attachment before fallible follow-up, transport attachment before marker release, monitored main-thread I/O, PID roles/kernel scope, exact argv, wrong/partial marker/EOF, source drift, callback raise/non-None and failed closeout custody. Both original groups and provider home/prompt must be absent before callback/return. No model/auth call.

qualification_stages.scope: Original real report-only candidate/native validation/controller callback
qualification_stages.requires: Actual original task/board revision and consumed attempt observation; supported opt-in report-only daemon checkpoint; independent actual frozen candidate observation; real source context and separately genuine VALIDATION; private one-use handle and separate ORCHESTRATION controller CAS. Preserve two consumed attempts, total cap 3 and all 63 future blocked tasks.

qualification_stages.scope: Exact pre-effect quota-only Codex GPT 6.1 Sol backup
qualification_stages.requires: A separate reviewed generation genuinely accounts/gates every productive preflight and fallback child, independently observes fresh quota-only decision and closes each actual scope. V01 refuses these options before invocation; post-task-dispatch fallback prohibition remains unchanged.

failure_policy: No callback/returned success on failed provider, changed birth/source/route/owner, unfinished native group or unknown Docker/kernel cleanup. Failure-finally independently rechecks original daemon/CID/name and captured kernel scope after marker release. Provider-home/prompt remnants refuse. OrdinaryCustodyPending exposes actual in-memory cleanup references only; caller must retain both original native contexts until independent cleanup proves quiescence. No exception-as-grant, copied CAS authority, blind kill, retry reset or policy bypass.
remaining_factual_context_fields: Hook does not invent original task CID/revision, native attempt ID, consumed ordinal or host receipt hashes. Trusted integration must independently observe those joins and seal the actual report before native validation.
